label: Altititude Indicator
author: Conky-Studio
description: Aircraft artificial-horizon style gauge. Pitch (vertical shift) and Bank (roll rotation) inputs. Decorative / aviation HUD element — not a real AHRS.

properties.label: Pitch
properties.help: Degrees nose-up positive. Mapped into vertical sky/ground shift.

properties.label: Bank
properties.help: Roll degrees; positive = right wing down.

lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
 local pitch = tonumber({pitch}) or 0
 local bank = tonumber({bank}) or 0
 local sr, sg, sb = {sky_color}
 local gr, gg, gb = {ground_color}
 local lr, lg, lb = {line_color}
 local br, bg, bb = {bezel_color}
 -- clip to circle
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_clip(cr)
 cairo_translate(cr, cx, cy)
 cairo_rotate(cr, math.rad(bank))
 local py = pitch * {pitch_scale}
 -- sky
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, sr, sg, sb, {opacity})
 cairo_rectangle(cr, -R * 1.5, -R * 1.5 + py, R * 3, R * 1.5)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 -- ground
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, gr, gg, gb, {opacity})
 cairo_rectangle(cr, -R * 1.5, py, R * 3, R * 1.5)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 -- horizon line
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, lr, lg, lb, {opacity})
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 2)
 cairo_move_to(cr, -R * 1.2, py)
 cairo_line_to(cr, R * 1.2, py)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 -- pitch ladder
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1.2)
 for step = -40, 40, 10 do
  if step ~= 0 then
   local yy = py - step * {pitch_scale}
   local half = (math.abs(step) % 20 == 0) and 18 or 10
   cairo_move_to(cr, -half, yy); cairo_line_to(cr, half, yy); cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
 end
 cairo_restore(cr)
 -- fixed aircraft symbol
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, lr, lg, lb, {opacity})
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 2.5)
 cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
 cairo_move_to(cr, cx - 22, cy); cairo_line_to(cr, cx - 8, cy); cairo_stroke(cr)
 cairo_move_to(cr, cx + 8, cy); cairo_line_to(cr, cx + 22, cy); cairo_stroke(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, 4, 0, 2 * math.pi); cairo_stroke(cr)
 -- bezel ring
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 3)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, br, bg, bb, {opacity})
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 -- bank marks on bezel
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 2)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, lr, lg, lb, {opacity} * 0.85)
 for _, deg in ipairs({-60, -45, -30, -20, -10, 0, 10, 20, 30, 45, 60}) do
  local a = math.rad(-90 + deg)
  local len = (deg == 0 or math.abs(deg) == 30 or math.abs(deg) == 60) and 10 or 6
  cairo_move_to(cr, cx + math.cos(a) * (R - 2), cy + math.sin(a) * (R - 2))
  cairo_line_to(cr, cx + math.cos(a) * (R - 2 - len), cy + math.sin(a) * (R - 2 - len))
  cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
